message.content: Based on the conversations recorded, LiHua expresses admiration for Messi's overall contribution to the sport, particularly highlighting his ability to create chances out of nothing and his vision on the field. LiHua also emphasizes Messi's work ethic and humility, noting that these qualities inspire future generations of players. LiHua describes Messi as someone who "approaches the game" with dedication and consistency, setting a high standard for future players. Additionally, LiHua points out that Messi's performances, including moments like his solo goal against Getafe in 2007 and his header in the Champions League against Manchester United in 2011, showcase his exceptional skill and unpredictability, further cementing his status as one of the greatest players of all time.
